definitions.explanation: The portion of a passage marked with an underline. Standard wording in exam questions and textbook exercises, which routinely ask about {下線部|かせんぶ}.

examples.japanese: {下線部|かせんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訳|やく}し→訳す：02319_yakusu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
{下線部|かせんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain the meaning of the underlined part.

examples.japanese: {下線部|かせんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}している→指す：02056_sasu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{本文|ほんぶん}→本文：13064_honbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Find in the passage what the underlined part refers to, and answer accordingly.

notes:
From ⟦{下線|かせん}→下線：00190_kasen⟧ (underline) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part). When several passages are underlined they are numbered: {下線部|かせんぶ}(1), {下線部|かせんぶ}(2).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下線部|かせんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訳|やく}す→訳す：02319_yakusu⟧: to translate the underlined part
- {下線部|かせんぶ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer about the underlined part
- ⟦{下線|かせん}→下線：00190_kasen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to underline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}→傍線部：30437_bousenbu⟧: the marked part — the same idea in Japanese-language exams, where the line runs beside vertical text
- ⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧: blank — the gap to be filled in a fill-in-the-blank question
